<script lang="ts">
import { variants } from "../utils";

/** NavItem: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
export const navItemVariants = variants({
  base: "flex w-full items-center p-2 rounded",
  variants: {
    level: {
      "1": "",
      "2": "",
      "3": "pr-2 pl-12",
      "4": "pr-2 pl-20",
    },
    state: {
      default: "",
      selected: "",
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: { level: "1", state: "default" },
});
/** NavItem: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
export const navItemContentVariants = variants({
  base:
    "flex h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground " +
    "inset-ring inset-ring-transparent rounded",
  variants: {
    level: {
      "1": "",
      "2": "",
      "3": "px-2",
      "4": "px-2",
    },
    state: {
      default: "",
      selected: "bg-background text-foreground inset-ring-border",
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: { level: "1", state: "default" },
});

export type NavItemProps = {
  selected?: boolean;
  level?: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4";
  href?: string;
  interactive?: boolean;
  reserveRight?: boolean;
  contentClass?: string;
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../primitives/link-plain/link-plain.vue";
import NavItemRow from "../components/nav-item-row.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  selected = false,
  level,
  href,
  interactive = false,
  reserveRight = false,
  contentClass,
  class: className,
} = defineProps<NavItemProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ click: [] }>();
defineSlots<{ default?(): unknown, icon?(): unknown, right?(): unknown }>();
const state = computed(() => selected ? "selected" : "default");
const outer = computed(() =>
  cn(
    navItemVariants({ level: level, state: state.value }),
    "group in-data-[nav=collapsed]:justify-center",
    className,
  )
);
const inner = computed(() =>
  cn(
    navItemContentVariants({ level: level, state: state.value }),
    (!selected && "group-hover:bg-muted"),
    "in-data-[nav=collapsed]:w-10 in-data-[nav=collapsed]:flex-none in-data-[nav=collapsed]:justify-center in-data-[nav=collapsed]:px-0",
    contentClass,
  )
);
</script>

<template>
  <LinkPlain v-if="href"
    :href="href"
    :class="outer"
    :aria-current="(selected ? 'page' : undefined)"
    data-slot="nav-item"
    :data-state="state"
    @click="() => emit('click')"
  >
    <NavItemRow :inner="inner" :reserveRight="reserveRight">
      <template v-if="$slots.icon" #icon><slot name="icon" /></template>
      <template v-if="$slots.right" #right><slot name="right" /></template>
      <template v-if="$slots.default" #default><slot /></template>
    </NavItemRow>
  </LinkPlain>
  <ButtonPlain v-else-if="interactive"
    type="button"
    :class="cn(outer, 'text-left')"
    :aria-current="(selected ? 'page' : undefined)"
    data-slot="nav-item"
    :data-state="state"
    @click="() => emit('click')"
  >
    <NavItemRow :inner="inner" :reserveRight="reserveRight">
      <template v-if="$slots.icon" #icon><slot name="icon" /></template>
      <template v-if="$slots.right" #right><slot name="right" /></template>
      <template v-if="$slots.default" #default><slot /></template>
    </NavItemRow>
  </ButtonPlain>
  <Box
    v-else
    :class="outer"
    :aria-current="(selected ? 'page' : undefined)"
    data-slot="nav-item"
    :data-state="state"
  >
    <NavItemRow :inner="inner" :reserveRight="reserveRight">
      <template v-if="$slots.icon" #icon><slot name="icon" /></template>
      <template v-if="$slots.right" #right><slot name="right" /></template>
      <template v-if="$slots.default" #default><slot /></template>
    </NavItemRow>
  </Box>
</template>
